Return a concise rationale for the selected priority and at most two concrete methodology steps for this section. Do not compare this company with another company. The supplied response_contract is authoritative for the complete JSON shape. Obey response_contract.compact_limits exactly and keep questions, steps, rationale, and focus items concise. Do not fill optional lists merely to reach their maxima.
